description: This file implements the RestorableFile class, which manages safe file operations including creating backups, committing temporary files, restoring backups, and cleanup, within the Android installd component.

classes.name: RestorableFile
classes.description: A class providing mechanisms to safely modify files with backup and restore capabilities within Android's installd service.

methods.name: CreateBackupFile
methods.description: Creates a backup of the current file by renaming it with a .backup suffix.

methods.name: CommitWorkFile
methods.description: Commits a temporary file as the main file, renaming the temp to the original.

methods.name: RestoreBackupFile
methods.description: Restores the backup file to the original filename.

methods.name: CreateWritableFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary writable file with specified permissions.

methods.name: ResetAndRemoveAllFiles
methods.description: Resets the object and removes all related files (temp, backup, original).
